title: SAP Taulia - SAP-integrated working capital and supply chain finance platform
clean_text: SAP Taulia is a supply chain finance and working capital management platform, founded in 2009 with over 2 million business users, covering payables, receivables, and inventory financing through a network connecting buyers, suppliers, and financial institutions. Its Multifunder capability provides additional liquidity beyond a single funding source, and its Cloud Integration Gateway connects SAP, Taulia, and other systems through one managed integration layer. More than 80% of Taulia's customer base runs SAP as their core ERP, and the platform is best suited to organizations that want to implement and self-manage their own supplier financing programs, primarily across the US and Europe.
